title: How to enable OOP calibration?
symptom: The user cannot enable OOP calibration because the checkbox is always grayed out. They ask for step-by-step instructions to enable this feature.
cause: The feature is not supported; it is a pre-alpha feature with serious drawbacks if enabled.
fix: No fix is provided; the maintainer states it is not supported and unlikely to change. A workaround is mentioned by a user: editing the XML settings file to change 'calibrate_external_libre_algorithm' from 'false' to 'true' and reloading settings, but this is not endorsed.
evidence_quote: No. This is not supported. It's a pre-alpha feature that has some serious drawbacks if enabled.
